title: equiparity: code and measurement records for "The parity gap in crystal tensor prediction"
description: Code, configurations and frozen measurement records for "The parity gap in crystal tensor prediction". Provides matched O(3)/SO(3) model builders for NequIP, Allegro and MACE with a parity verification gate, the equiparity command-line interface for training, data preparation, aggregation and release checks, the result records behind every figure and table with an execution manifest of all training runs, and a Lean 4 formalization of the parity-gap guarantees.
